catholic-encyclopedia-1913-chrestien-lec: This 1913 reference piece on Chrestien Le Clercq — the Recollect of the Mi'kmaq. Odoric Jouve honors his missionary toil. His Nouvelle Relation told the tale. The Gaspé knew his zealous care. The apostle of the eastern woods. His Gaspésie mission was the Recollects' own.
nasa-tm-19670024078-psk-subcarrier-demod:
V. J. DiLosa and V. R. Simas, of NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center in Maryland, wrote this paper in April 1967. It covers demodulators for PSK subcarriers in spacecraft data systems. Phase-shift keying packs digital data onto a radio subcarrier, and the demodulator is the ground circuit that pulls clean data back out of it.

At the time, general-purpose signal conditioners were doing that job inside the tracking network, although they were never designed for it. The report lists their faults: poor filtering before subcarrier regeneration, a weak phase lock loop. Their filtering also matched the subcarrier rate instead of the data rate. A purpose-built PSK subcarrier demodulator, the analysis shows, performs very close to ideal. At threshold it should deliver about ten decibels more sensitivity than the conditioners then in use.
